manuscript: Teacher-Anchored Differentiable Sequence–Ensemble Learning for Explainable Insider Threat Detection
scientific_purpose: Cross-release portability of explainable insider-threat detectors under heterogeneous CERT releases, where strong within-release ranking and teacher-relative fidelity do not guarantee ranking or decision portability.
cross_release_limitation: CERT releases belong to the same synthetic benchmark lineage. The Generation-2 experiment evaluates cross-release transfer within that benchmark family. It does not establish cross-organisation, cross-population, or real-world external generalisation.
